newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's weekly forex demand rises to $76.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's weekly forex demand rises to $76.9 mln.

text.p: Nigeria's central bank said on Friday it sold $76.9 million at a rate of 80 to the dollar at its weekly auction this week compared to $59.5 million at the same rate last week.
Two weeks ago the bank sold only $887,494 at the same rate as most banks shunned the auction in anticipation of changes to the forex regime as they awaited the 1997 fiscal budget.

The budget was presented shortly after the announcement of the retention of the dual exchange rate, under which a few government transactions are done at the official rate of 22 naira to the dollar but all other business is done at market rates derived from the auction.
"The auction market is seeing some pent-up demand which is now being released," said one banker.
